summary: Implemented efficient SQL window-function support in the pure-Python executor. Added planner window stages with QUALIFY ordering, named-window inheritance, grouped aggregate materialization, and support through joins/subqueries/CTEs. Added executor evaluation for ranking, aggregate, navigation, ROWS/RANGE/GROUPS frames, exclusions, NULL behavior, ordering, and IGNORE NULLS using prefix structures, binary search, and segment trees. Adjusted window-query optimization to avoid unsafe subquery rewrites and preserved qualified column ranges during sorting. Validated with broad functional, composition, grouped, named-window, join, correlated-subquery, regression, and 50,000-row performance tests.
